literal_meaning: অস্তিত্ব এবং অস্তিত্বের অভাব (existence and non-existence)
figurative_meaning_en: being present or absent; here one moment and gone the next
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জ্বর অস্তিনাস্তি, ডাক্তার বলেছে সতর্ক থাকতে।
বাজারের দাম অস্তিনাস্তি, কোনো দিন বাড়ে কোনো দিন পড়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: His fever is touch and go; the doctor said to stay vigilant.
The market prices are here today, gone tomorrow; they rise one day and fall the next.
history: Derived from Sanskrit philosophical concepts in Hindu texts, often used in Bengali literature to denote impermanence.
note: The idiom reflects deeper philosophical undertones from Vedantic ideas of being and non-being.
